predictions.rationale: Central class representing a Deployment Diagram within the main ArgoUML application; owns diagram behaviour, nodes, and edges.
Provides the graph model that backs Deployment Diagrams by mapping UML elements (nodes, artifacts) onto the diagram.
Renderer responsible for visualizing nodes and artifacts specific to Deployment Diagrams.
UI action that creates a new Deployment Diagram; directly ties user command to diagram construction.
Initialisation class that registers diagram, renderer, and actions for Deployment Diagram feature at application start-up.
Property panel dedicated to Deployment Diagrams, letting users view/edit diagram-level properties.
Factory that supplies the property panel for Deployment Diagrams; supports integration with generic UI tooling.
Model-layer representation or helper for Deployment Diagrams, enabling diagram persistence and API access.
Alternate/second-generation deployment diagram implementation in the deployment2 module.
Graph model for the deployment2 version of Deployment Diagrams; supports nodes/artifacts mapping.
